name: mosaic-token-extensions-admin
description: TypeScript SDK, CLI, and UI for managing standard token types on Solana (ex: Stablecoin & Arcade Tokens)

scripts.precommit: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:fix
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run type-check

author: Solana Foundation

pnpm._dependencyNotes: These overrides pin the whole workspace onto the Solana Kit v6 ecosystem. Kit is capped at 6.x (not the newer 7.x) because the token-acl SDKs (@solana/token-acl-sdk, @solana/token-acl-gate-sdk) peer-depend on @solana/kit ^6.0.0. @solana-program/token-2022 is pinned to 0.10.0 (which already peers kit ^6): it still ships the confidential-transfer InstructionPlan/derive helpers the confidential feature needs, which were removed in 0.12.0. @solana/token-acl-sdk@0.4.0 hard-depends on token-2022 0.12.0 but is forced down to 0.10.0 here — safe because it only consumes stable core token-2022 exports unchanged across 0.10-0.12. Two packages still declare v5 kit ranges but are safe on v6 because they only touch codecs/signers/addresses (unchanged v5->v6): @solana-program/zk-elgamal-proof and @solana/connector are forced onto v6 via the @solana/kit override and the @solana/* transitive overrides. @solana/zk-sdk is pinned to exactly 0.5.2 (HOO-1595) so packages/sdk and apps/app resolve a single copy of the WASM module — a second copy breaks `instanceof` class identity. See packages/sdk/package.json `_dependencyNotes`.
pnpm._securityOverridesNotes: The range-scoped overrides after @solana/zk-sdk are security floors for transitive dependencies flagged by Dependabot (HOO-2092). Each one lifts only the vulnerable versions of one major line to the lowest release clear of every known GitHub advisory, and every target is inside the declared range of the parents that pull it in, so no parent is forced across a major: nanoid 3.x >= 3.3.18, browserslist 4.x >= 4.28.7, baseline-browser-mapping 2.x >= 2.11.0, brace-expansion 1.x >= 1.1.21 / 2.x >= 2.1.7 / 5.x >= 5.0.12 (1.1.18, 2.1.4 and 5.0.9 are still hit by newer advisories), minimatch 3.x >= 3.1.4 / 9.x >= 9.0.7, source-map-js 1.x >= 1.2.2, bn.js 5.x >= 5.2.3. Dev-only tooling (test runner, lint, changesets): handlebars 4.x >= 4.7.10 (via ts-jest), js-yaml 3.x >= 3.15.2 / 4.x >= 4.3.2, flatted 3.x >= 3.4.2, picomatch 2.x >= 2.3.2 / 4.x >= 4.0.4, ajv 6.x >= 6.14.0, @humanfs/node 0.16.x >= 0.16.8. They are guards against a later lockfile regeneration resolving an old copy again; drop an entry once no parent in the tree can resolve a vulnerable version.
